relationships.description: Both study how interaction data supports training GUI agents; no direct pipeline dependency is claimed.
Trajectory synthesis and trajectory judgment address complementary parts of agent training.
Both provide live task environments and benchmarks, with scientific workflows and mobile safety as distinct targets.
Safety detection and task-success judgment assess different properties of agent trajectories.
Both coordinate specialized capabilities within a generalist computer-assistant framework.
ScienceBoard includes an OS-Atlas model configuration for scientific-workflow evaluation.
